families.description: The sign a body is in at an instant given to the minute in UTC.
The sign a body is in on a date, with no time or zone given: DEPENDS when it changes sign during that date in some UTC offset.
Whether a planet is retrograde on a date: DEPENDS when it stations during that date in some UTC offset.
The date a body enters a sign, in a year, or for the Moon a month, in which it enters that sign exactly once.
The date of a new moon, first quarter, full moon or last quarter, in a month that has exactly one.

instructions.sign: Answer with only the name of the sign.
instructions.sign-or-depends: If the answer depends on the time of day or the time zone, answer DEPENDS; otherwise answer with only the name of the sign.
instructions.yes-no-depends: If the answer depends on the time of day or the time zone, answer DEPENDS; otherwise answer YES or NO.
instructions.date: Answer with only the date, as YYYY-MM-DD.
